_note: Starter feature catalogue (Part A of the industries brief). Loaded into Firestore by `npm run seed`; after that, superadmin edits the live copy in /superadmin. Keys are stable identifiers: rename the name, never the key. Keys starting with area. switch whole areas of the app on or off for a company.
